00_acilis: When you open Netice, a short opening animation welcomes you.
01_tanitim: On first launch you see a few pages introducing the app. Tap Continue to move on.
02_ana: The home screen shows a summary of your exams. Tap the plus button at the top right for a new exam, or Scan to read answer sheets.
03_siniflar: Switch to Classes in the bottom menu. Import your students from an Excel list, or add them one by one with Add student.
04_yeni_sinav: On the new exam screen, choose the number of questions and choices, enter the answer key with the buttons, and tap Save exam.
05_form_yazdir: On the exam screen, choose Print forms from the menu at the top right and hand out the answer sheets.
06_okut: When the exam is over, tap the Scan button.
07_okut_ekrani: Scan the sheets with the camera or pick their photos from the gallery. Netice reads each sheet in seconds.
08_sonuclar: The Results tab shows each student's correct, wrong and blank answers and their score.
09_analiz: From the Analysis tab you can get the exam report and student report cards as PDF.
10_ogrenci: The student page shows progress and warns you about students whose results are dropping.
11_ayarlar: In Settings you can change the app language and back up your data.
12_yardim: If you get stuck, check the guide and the frequently asked questions in the Help tab. Enjoy!
